steps.en: Install a surface — the editor extension, or the cn command-line agent
steps.zh: 装一个入口：编辑器扩展，或 cn 命令行 agent

steps.en: Declare models, rules and MCP servers once, and commit the file with the repo
steps.zh: 把模型、规则和 MCP server 声明一遍，随仓库提交

steps.en: Every surface reads the same config, so the editor and the CLI behave identically
steps.zh: 所有入口读同一份配置，编辑器和命令行行为一致

steps.en: Hand it a task in the editor, or run it headless from a script or CI job
steps.zh: 在编辑器里派活，或在脚本和 CI 里无界面运行

steps.en: Edits with the configured model and shows a diff you accept or reject
steps.zh: 用配置好的模型改代码，给出 diff 让你接受或拒绝

steps.en: In headless mode it answers as JSON, so the pipeline can read the result
steps.zh: 无界面模式下以 JSON 作答，流水线能直接解析

value.en: One checked-in config defines the agent wherever it runs — the editor, the terminal, or CI
value.zh: 一份入库的配置定义了 agent 在哪儿都一样的表现：编辑器、终端、CI
